definition: a young swan.
example_en: The young swan is swimming behind its mother.

definition: the quality or condition of being superior; superiority.
example: ಆ ರಾಜ್ಯ ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರಾಭವ ಹೊಂದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: That kingdom held superiority in the field of science.

definition: an alcoholic liquor made by fermenting the sweet sap of palms.
example: ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಜನ ಮರದ ಸಾರದಿಂದ ಉಡಿಗೆ ತಯಾರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The village people made toddy liquor from the sap of the tree.

definition: one who performs a ritualistic sacrifice.
example_en: The priest who performs the sacrifice carried out the ritual sacrifice according to the rules.

definition: a cloud.
example_en: The cloud spread across the sky along with thunder.

definition: that part of a relatively large meteoroid that survives passage through the atmosphere and falls to the surface of the earth; a meteorite.
example: ವಿಜ್ಞಾನಿಗಳು ಮರುಭೂಮಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸಿಕ್ಕ ಗಗನೋಪಲವನ್ನು ಸಂಶೋಧನೆಗೆ ಬಳಸಿದರು.
example_en: Scientists used the meteorite found in the desert for research.

definition: to go back to original or previous position or place; to retreat.
example_en: He retreated and came back to the previous place.

definition: a seller of betel leaves.
example_en: The betel leaf seller was selling betel leaves at the market.

definition: equal distance; equidistance.
example_en: The two railway tracks run at equal distance from each other.

definition: greatness; eminence; superiority; distinction.
example_en: The teacher's eminence was an ideal for the disciples.

definition: to do; to accomplish.
example_en: He accomplished this work well.

definition: a female swan.
example_en: The female swan was swimming near the pond.

definition: to become tight, close, fast.
example_en: When the rope was pulled, the knot became tight.

definition: that which wanders at will.
example: ಆ ಇಟ್ಚರ ಪ್ರಾಣಿಯನ್ನು ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾರೂ ಹಿಡಿಯಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: No one could catch that wandering-at-will animal in the forest.

definition: a sphereical mass; a ball.
example_en: She made a ball of dough and kept it.

definition: suddenly; unexpectedly; all of a sudden.
example_en: Clouds suddenly gathered in the sky.

definition: a man who delivers a lecture (esp. on a subject) to an audience; a lecturer.
example_en: That lecturer delivered a lecture at the assembly.

definition: something that is requested or sought by prayer.
example_en: God granted the boon sought in prayer by the devotee.

definition: the period from sunset to sunrise; night.
example_en: During the night, stars were seen filling the sky.

definition: any unrefined or undeveloped language.
example_en: Those tribal people speak an unrefined language.

definition: to go back; to retreat.
example_en: The soldiers retreated before the enemies.

definition: to turn and look back.
example_en: As if someone had called from behind, he turned and looked back.

definition: the first place; the foremost rank.
example_en: She secured the first rank in the examination.

definition: (one's courage, spirit) to get weakened.
example: ಭಯದ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನ ಎದೆ ಧಸ್ಸೆಂದಿತು.
example_en: On hearing the frightening news, his courage got weakened with a jolt.

definition: the act or positon of lying oneself on a flat, horizontal surface, usu. in a relaxed manner.
example_en: Lying down in the evening is not good for health.

definition: to make foul, dirty or unclean; to pollute; to debase.
example_en: Industries are polluting the river.

definition: an area having hills and hillocks.
example_en: The trekkers lost their way in that hilly region.

definition: deputation of a messenger or an ambassador; delegation.
example_en: The king sent a delegation to the enemy kingdom.

definition: the advent of rainy-clouds; beginning of rainy season.
example_en: With the advent of the rainy clouds, the trees sprouted new leaves.

definition: short, crisp sentences.
example: ಅವನ ಭಾಷಣ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಹುಡಿಮಾತುಗಳಿಂದ ಕೂಡಿತ್ತು.
example_en: His speech was made up of short, crisp sentences.

definition: one of the prominent cities in Karnāṭaka, former capital of the princely state Mysūru.
example_en: Formerly Mysore was the capital of a princely state.

definition: extreme sorrow; great affliction.
example_en: The great affliction of her son's death broke her down.

definition: (a crowd, mob) to disperse slightly.
example_en: As the police arrived, the crowd dispersed slightly.

definition: the act of becoming expanded, enlarged; dilation; expansion.
example_en: The expansion of the cloth from water was clearly visible.

definition: an obstacle; an impediment.
example_en: An impediment arose in his work.

definition: a particular stringed musical instrument.
example_en: The musician played the stringed instrument.

definition: the quality of person given to show and vanity.
example_en: People did not like his pretentiousness.

definition: cooked food.
example_en: At the temple, everyone received the cooked food.

definition: a mean act; a deed that brings dishonour.
example: ಅವನು ಮಾಡಿದ ಅೞಿಗೆಯ್ತ ಇಡೀ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ಕಳಂಕ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The mean act he committed brought disgrace to the whole family.

definition: to overpower or defeat another.
example_en: The army overpowered the enemies.

definition: the plant Cannabis sativa of Cannabianaceae family, grown for the tough its tough fibre.
example_en: The farmer grew the hemp plant in his field.

definition: to gently deflect, ward off.
example_en: The teacher gently warded off the blow of the stick with his hand.

definition: a common man.
example_en: He is an ordinary common man, not a king.

definition: cessation of life; death.
example: ಅವನ ಬರ್ದು ಇಡೀ ಊರನ್ನು ದುಃಖದಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಳುಗಿಸಿತು.
example_en: His death plunged the whole town into sorrow.

definition: the act or an instance of keeping a thing from being seen; a hiding or concealing.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ದುಃಖವನ್ನು ಉಪಗೂಹನ ಮಾಡಿ ಮುಗುಳ್ನಕ್ಕನು.
example_en: He hid his sorrow and smiled.

definition: a work that may be of any kind, but of lesser importance; miscellaneous work.
example_en: They gave him miscellaneous work to do.

definition: to convey an information, idea etc. through spoken words; to tell.
example_en: The teacher told the truth to the disciple.

definition: the quality or fact, of being unimaginable; unimaginableness.
example_en: The unimaginableness of that incident astonished everyone.

definition: a penalty imposed on an offender for a crime or wrongdoing; punishment.
example_en: The judge imposed a harsh punishment on him.

definition: the quality of being haughty, arrogant; haughtiness.
example_en: His haughtiness annoyed everyone.

definition: (a leaf) to germinate and develop.
example_en: The plant's leaf germinates and develops in the rainy season.

definition: want of taste.
example_en: Everyone noticed the want of taste in this dish.

definition: having a bad temper or cranky disposition; irritable; bad-tempered.
example_en: Everyone knew about his irritable, bad-tempered nature.

definition: a lodging place for students, working persons, etc.; a hosel.
example_en: The college students live in the hostel.

definition: a building for the confinement of persons held while awaiting trial, persons sentenced after conviction, etc.; a prison; a jail.
example_en: The prisoner was sent to the jail.

definition: the act of suppressing or being suppressed; suppression; restraint.
example_en: The government carried out the suppression of the protest.

definition: an elevated tract of more or less level land; a plateau.
example_en: Sheep were grazing on that plateau.

definition: making no angle; agonic.
example_en: Those lines met making no angle.

definition: a man who has the knowledge of the pure consciousness and hence, the spiritual power.
example: ಚಿಚ್ಛಾಸಕನು ತನ್ನ ಆಧ್ಯಾತ್ಮಿಕ ಶಕ್ತಿಯಿಂದ ಅನೇಕರಿಗೆ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶನ ನೀಡಿದನು.
example_en: The knower of pure consciousness guided many with his spiritual power.

definition: that which brings about the result; a cause.
example_en: The rain became the cause of the accident.

definition: a bad disposition; a bad mind.
example_en: His bad disposition caused trouble to everyone.

definition: a thorny bush.
example_en: The thorny bush got entangled on the forest path.

definition: a genus of fish.
example_en: The fishermen caught the fish called avega.

definition: a stone or rock.
example_en: The sculptor carved the rock and made an idol.

definition: a thin oil distilled from petroleum or shale oil, used as a fuel, solvent, illuminant, etc.; kerosene.
example_en: The lantern needs kerosene.

definition: a piece of furniture sanding on four legs with a flat rectangular surface to lay the bed and sleep on; a couch; a cot.
example_en: The child lay down on the cot.

definition: a short sickle with a heavy crescent-shaped blade.
example_en: The hunter tucked the short crescent sickle (kai maccu) into his waist.

definition: half-opened eye.
example: ನಿದ್ದೆಯಿಂದ ಎದ್ದ ಅವನ ಅರೆಗಣ್ ಇನ್ನೂ ತೆರೆದಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: His half-opened eye had not yet fully opened after waking from sleep.

definition: the ghost of a person who committed suicide by hanging oneself.
example: ಆ ಮರದ ಬಳಿ ಗರಾವು ಕಾಣಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆಂದು ಜನರು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: People say the ghost of a suicide victim appears near that tree.

definition: a brilliant precious variety of corundum of beautiful blue; sapphire.
example_en: A sapphire had been set into that ornament.

definition: of, belonging to originated in European countries, esp. in Germany, Austria.
example: ಆ ಅಲೇಮಾನ್ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಯ ಶೈಲಿ ಇಲ್ಲಿಗೆ ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: That European style of culture has come here.

definition: a punishing or being punished; chastisement; punishment.
example_en: The criminal was given punishment.

definition: in whatever way; by whatever means.
example_en: He finished that work by whatever means possible.

definition: a region that is not mountainous, but is almost level; the plains; open counry.
example_en: Farmers grow paddy in the plains.

definition: to kick as to fell.
example: ಕುದುರೆ ತನ್ನ ಹಿಂದಿನ ಕಾಲಿನಿಂದ ಎದುರಾಳಿಯನ್ನು ಒದೆಗೆಡಹಿತು.
example_en: The horse kicked its opponent down with its hind leg.

definition: bringing inward as the nerve that conveying impulses to the central nervous system; afferent.
example: ಈ ನರವು ಅಂತರ್ವಾಹಿ ಸಂಜ್ಞೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮೆದುಳಿಗೆ ಸಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: This nerve carries afferent signals inward to the brain.

definition: that which is very common, unimportant.
example_en: This is a very common, unimportant matter, don't worry.

definition: the sound produced by chiming bells.
example_en: A chiming sound of bells was heard from the dancer's anklets.

definition: the act, profession of a person who hunts animals.
example: ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬೇಟೆಯು ಅವನ ಕುಟುಂಬದ ಪರಂಪರೆಯ ವೃತ್ತಿಯಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Hunting in the forest was his family's traditional profession.

definition: to live together without hostility or conflict.
example_en: Brothers should always live together without hostility.

definition: a strong wish; a desire.
example_en: She had a strong desire to sing.

definition: to look down; to disregard; to lower one's value.
example_en: He disregarded his friend.

definition: to place in such and such a manner, position, predicament, etc.
example_en: He placed the book carefully in the cupboard.

definition: a word expressing objection or a doubt.
example: ಆದೊಡೆ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿ ಅವನು ಅಸಮಾಧಾನ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಪಡಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: Saying 'but', he expressed his objection.

definition: a man who deserves to be praised, commended.
example_en: The whole town respects that praiseworthy man.

definition: a silvery-white, brittle, nonmetallic chemical element of crystalline structure, used in collyrium; antimony.
example_en: Doctors use antimony for eye medicine.

definition: (dial.) the hair that has turned grey just above the ears of a woman.
example_en: The grey hair above her ears became visible.

definition: the plant Anisochilus carnosus of Lamiaceae family; thick leaved lavender.
example_en: The leaves of sāvirasambāra are used for medicine.

definition: an interjection used to point out an object which is relatively near.
example_en: Here, your sandal is right here.

definition: high; tall.
example_en: That tower was so tall it seemed to touch the sky.

definition: the act or an instance of bidding higher than others in an auction.
example_en: The higher bid drew the attention of the whole gathering.

definition: to make sharp or sharper; to sharpen; to whet.
example_en: The blacksmith whetted the sickle.

definition: the nut of the tree Sapindus emarginatus (= S. trifoliatus, S. lauriolius) of Sapindaceae family, used as soap; soapnut.
example_en: They use soapnut instead of shampoo for the hair.

definition: official expenditure.
example_en: The official expenditure of the office has increased a lot.

definition: a device for pulling corks out of bottles, usu. a spiral-shaped piece of steel with a point at one end and a handle at the other; a cork-screw.
example_en: She keeps a corkscrew in the kitchen.

definition: the state of being perplexed.
example_en: She suddenly became perplexed.

definition: the chief officer of a village.
example_en: The village chief officer was having the tax accounts written.

definition: a piece of furniture standing on four legs with a flat rectangular surface to lay the bed and to sleep on; a couch; a cot.
example: ಅಜ್ಜ ಪಲಕ್ಕಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಮಲಗಿ ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ ಪಡೆದನು.
example_en: Grandfather lay on the cot and rested.

definition: a weapon consisting of a long shaft, with a pointed end, used for throwing at or stabbing; a spear.
example_en: The spear was gleaming in the warrior's hand.

definition: to hit with the hand or a tool, weapon, etc. with an intention to hurt; to strike.
example_en: In anger, he struck the table with a hammer.

definition: either of a pair of long, thin runners of wood, metal, etc., fastened to the shoes for gliding over snow; a ski.
example: ಅವನು ಕಾಲುಕೊರಡು ಧರಿಸಿ ಹಿಮದ ಮೇಲೆ ಜಾರಿದನು.
example_en: He wore skis and glided over the snow.

definition: an erstwhile gold coin.
example_en: Grandmother had kept a gold coin in the box.

definition: a pot burned or baked in a kiln.
example_en: They filled water in the kiln-baked pot and kept it.

definition: a great number of people gathered together; a crowd; a multitude.
example_en: A great crowd had gathered at the fair.

definition: being at the end; last; final.
example_en: This was the final round of the competition.

definition: in intermediate way.
example_en: The color of that cloth is in an intermediate way.

definition: the innate capacity, calibre.
example_en: His innate calibre became known during the hard times.

definition: the state of being somewhat dark; dimness.
example_en: In the dimness of the evening the birds returned to their nests.

definition: the moustachewho has grown in curls on either side of the face.
example: ಆ ವೃದ್ಧನ ಗುಜುಱುಮೀಸೆ ಎರಡೂ ಕಡೆ ಸುರುಳಿಯಾಗಿ ತಿರುಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The old man's curled moustache had twisted into curls on both sides of his face.

definition: a small crane (Anthropoides virgo) of Africa and Asia, demoiselle.
example: ಗದ್ದೆಯ ಬದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಕಕ್ರ ಪಕ್ಷಿ ನಡೆದಾಡುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A demoiselle crane was walking about beside the paddy field.

definition: that which is laudable.
example_en: His conduct is laudable to everyone.

definition: the profession of a washing clothes.
example: ಅವನ ಕುಟುಂಬ ತಲತಲಾಂತರದಿಂದ ಮಡಿವುಳಿಗ ಮಾಡುತ್ತ ಬಂದಿದೆ.
example_en: His family has been doing the washerman's profession for generations.

definition: the plant Pisum sativum of Papilionaceae family.
example_en: They were selling fresh peas at the market.

definition: the official residence of a king; a palace.
example_en: The king lived in the palace.

definition: with speed; swiftly; quickly.
example_en: The cart moved swiftly all along the way.

definition: (mus.) a particular kind of time-keeping.
example_en: The singers sang the song in the goshtikalyana time-keeping.

definition: an agricultural implement used for cutting, lifting, turning over, and partly pulverising soil; a plough.
example: ಹಳವನ್ನು ಎತ್ತುಗಳ ಸಹಾಯದಿಂದ ಎಳೆದು ಉಳುಮೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: They plough by dragging the plough with the help of oxen.

definition: a man who talks uselessly; an empty talker.
example_en: No one listens to the talk of that empty talker.

definition: to change the state of a solid or gaseous substance to liquid form; to liquefy.
example_en: They liquefied the wax by applying heat.

definition: to be unable to move; to become immobile.
example_en: He became unable to move due to leg pain.

definition: an ornamental tuft of hairs, feathers, etc. for decorating cattle, horse, etc.
example_en: They tied a coloured ornamental tuft around the bullock's neck.

definition: to rub or scrape slightly, as with the fingernails, to relieve itching; to scratch.
example_en: When it itched, the child scratched its hand.

definition: a man who has been given a land, village, etc. as a tax-free gift and holding feudal rights.
example_en: That jagirdar was the master of the entire village.

definition: the quality of being boastful.
example_en: His boastfulness stood out clearly in the gathering.

definition: the medium sized deciduous tree Feronia elephantum of Rutaceae family; wood apple tree.
example_en: There is an old wood apple tree in the garden.

definition: a wood piece used as fuel for cooking food .
example_en: Firewood was needed for the kitchen stove.

definition: a fixed period of time.
example: ಒಂದು ಮುದತಿಯ ನಂತರ ಅವರು ಮತ್ತೆ ಭೇಟಿಯಾದರು.
example_en: After a fixed period of time, they met again.

definition: drops or droplets of water.
example: ಎಲೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ನೀರ್ದಂದಲ್ ಬೆಳಗಿನ ಬಿಸಿಲಿಗೆ ಹೊಳೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದವು.
example_en: Droplets of water on the leaves glistened in the morning sun.

definition: a kind of mollusc.
example_en: A mollusc was found on the sea shore.

definition: the inner diameter of a granary.
example: ಕಣಜದ ಅಡ್ಡದಂಡೆಯನ್ನು ಅಳತೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಧಾನ್ಯ ತುಂಬಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: They measured the inner diameter of the granary and filled it with grain.

definition: an extent of land whose surface is made of sand only; a sandy land.
example: ಕರಾವಳಿ ಪ್ರದೇಶದ ಬಹುಪಾಲು ಸಿಕತಿಲ ಪ್ರದೇಶವೇ ಇದೆ.
example_en: Most of the coastal region is sandy land.

definition: the act or process of straining, pouring a liquid.
example: ಅವಳು ಹಾಲನ್ನು ಬಟ್ಟೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಸಿತ ಮಾಡಿ ಸೋಸಿದಳು.
example_en: She strained the milk through a cloth.

definition: the act of tiying, binding (to or together).
example_en: Before the war, the soldiers' preparation (binding together) was completed.

definition: to thrust a thing into another (esp. water) by force.
example_en: He thrust the cloth forcefully into the water.

definition: the helm - a) the wheel or tiller by which a ship or boat is steered; b) the complete steering gear, including the wheel or tiller, rudder, etc.
example_en: The captain held the helm firmly during the storm.

definition: a deputy chief of a jury.
example_en: The deputy chief of the jury looked after the panel's work.

definition: binding; restrictive.
example_en: These rules are of a very restrictive nature.

definition: a young person in serfdom or bondage.
example_en: The young bondservant served his master all day.

definition: the mood that is under grief, despondency, dejection, etc.
example: ಗೆಳೆಯನ ಸಾವಿನಿಂದ ಅವನ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಬ್ಬೆದೆ ಆವರಿಸಿತು.
example_en: Grief and dejection filled his mind at his friend's death.

definition: to lose one's course.
example_en: He lost his course in the thick fog.

definition: wide; vast; broad.
example: ಆ ನದಿಯ ರುಂದ್ರ ಹರವು ನೋಡುಗರನ್ನು ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The wide, vast expanse of that river drew the onlookers.

definition: brownish red colour.
example_en: The color of that cloth is brownish red.

definition: separated from; detached.
example_en: He lived alone, detached from everyone.

definition: a beloved man.
example_en: Her beloved man went to a distant town.

definition: military branch or unit that orders, stores, and supplies ordnance; ordnance.
example: ಸೇನೆಗೆ ಬೇಕಾದ ಫಿರಂಗಿಗಳನ್ನು ಗೋಲಂದಾಜು ಇಲಾಖೆ ಪೂರೈಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The ordnance department supplies the cannons needed for the army.

definition: a machine for separating cotton fibres from the seeds; a ginning machine.
example_en: The factory's ginning machine separated the cotton seeds.

definition: (acting, reacting, thinking etc.) quickly, meticulously or cautiously.
example_en: He got up quickly and set out for work.

definition: the act of telling, narrating.
example_en: The grandmother's telling was much loved by the children.

definition: application of the findings and methods of experimental, clinical, and social psychology to industrial concerns; industrial psychology.
example_en: They applied industrial psychology in the factory.

definition: the lower portion of a raised bund on the side of a water tank, canal, etc.
example: ಕಾಲುವೆಯ ಕೀೞೇರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರು ನಿಂತು ಹುಲ್ಲು ಬೆಳೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: Water has stagnated and grass has grown on the lower portion of the bund of the canal.

definition: a tool with a curved or hooked blade at one end, for pruning and cutting; a bill-hook.
example_en: He pruned the branches of the plant with the bill-hook.

definition: a teacher; a master.
example: ನಮ್ಮ ಮೇಷ್ಟರು ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಶಿಸ್ತಾಗಿ ಪಾಠ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Our teacher teaches lessons disciplinedly every day.

definition: a blank book for the insertion of photographs, postage stamps, etc.; an album.
example_en: She arranged the old photos in an album.

definition: to come together or along with.
example_en: They set out on the pilgrimage coming along with the guru.

definition: a room in the upper storey of a house.
example_en: Grandmother used to sit in the upper-storey room and tell stories.

definition: the act of cutting, severing.
example_en: The cutting of the bamboo was done by skilled hands.

definition: phlegm - a) that one of the three humors of the body, as perāyurvēda, which causes sluggishness or dullness; b) the thick, stringy mucus secreted by the mucous glands of the respiratory tract and discharged from the throat, as during a cold.
example_en: Because of the cold his phlegm thickened.

definition: a small, hand-held percussion instrument with a leather membrane played on with either hands or a stick.
example_en: At the festival they played the small hand drum and sang songs.

definition: a cloud.
example_en: The cloud moved across the sky, thundering.

definition: of this type, manner, style.
example_en: This style of clothing is in fashion now.

definition: very first.
example_en: This is his very first novel.

definition: that which keep its form rather than to flow or spread out like a liquid or gas; a solid substance.
example_en: A stone is a solid substance.

definition: the condition or fact of carrying the foetus of an offspring developing in the uterus.
example: ಆಕೆ ಸೂಲಿನ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ ಪಡೆದಳು.
example_en: She took more rest during her pregnancy.

definition: name of a folk goddess.
example_en: A fair is held every year for the folk goddess Hūḷaje.

definition: consisting of; composed of; containing.
example_en: That book consists of many chapters.

definition: to become loyal, faithfull to.
example_en: That soldier became loyal to the king.

definition: a mad, insane man.
example_en: That insane man ran about the street shouting.

definition: the middle sized, evergreen tree Barringtonia acutangula of Lecythidaceae family, the wood of which is used in boat building; Indian oak.
example_en: An Indian oak tree had grown on the bank of the pond.

definition: a punishing or being punished for a crime, violation, wrongdoing, etc.; punishment.
example_en: The court imposed punishment on the thief.

definition: (the settled sediments) to get disturbed; (the solid particles in a liquid) to come up.
example_en: The pond's bottom sediments got disturbed while the children were playing.

definition: the tree Anthocephalus indicus (= A. cadamba, = Nauclea cadamba) of Rubiaceae family; cadamba tree.
example: ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನದ ಬಳಿ ಒಂದು ಕಳಂಬ ಮರ ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a cadamba tree near the temple.

definition: the tip of the tongue.
example_en: She tasted the dish with the tip of her tongue.

definition: not disturbed or troubled by noise; calm.
example_en: In the evening the shore of the lake was calm.

definition: to hold, seize firmly.
example_en: He seized the branch firmly.

definition: a game of chance in which people buy numbered tickets, and prizes are given to those whose numbers are drawn by lot; lottery.
example: ಆತ ಸೋಡ್ತಿ ಟಿಕೆಟ್ ಖರೀದಿಸಿ ಬಹುಮಾನ ಗೆದ್ದನು.
example_en: He bought a lottery ticket and won a prize.

definition: the tough shell of a tortoise.
example_en: The fishermen removed the tough tortoise shell and made bangles.

definition: placed, pushed or kept low.
example_en: That officer was placed low in the meeting.

definition: an earthen frying-pan.
example_en: A dosa was being cooked in the earthen frying-pan in the kitchen.

definition: a spear or lance held in the hand.
example_en: He held the hand-lance and stood guard.

definition: a variety of pigeon gram, used as a food.
example_en: Mother cooked the Channangi pigeon gram and served it for the meal.

definition: a man who adheres, follows or executes the commands orders of (another).
example_en: That officer was a loyal executor of the king's commands.

definition: a younger brother.
example_en: His younger brother took up the responsibility of the household.

definition: (more by) one thousand times.
example: ಅವನ ಆಸ್ತಿ ಈಗ ಹಿಂದಿಗಿಂತ ಸಾಸಿರ್ಮಡಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: His wealth has now increased a thousand times more than before.

definition: a bad but strong habit.
example_en: Gambling has become his bad habit.

definition: gracefully; charmingly.
example_en: She speaks charmingly.

definition: to express a wish or desire for; ask for, esp. in a polite or formal way; to request; to supplicate.
example_en: She requested her father politely for money.

definition: the act of distinguishing differences between big and small, important and unimportant, etc.; discrimination.
example_en: That scholar well knew the discrimination between the important and unimportant.

definition: to go under the surface of a liquid; to plunge.
example_en: The swimmer plunged into the pond and searched for fish.

definition: that which is thick or dense.
example_en: The thickness of that wall was very solid.

definition: a man who deceives others by his hypocritical means; a hypocrite; a deceiver.
example_en: The hypocrite's deception was exposed very soon.

definition: truth; fact.
example: ಅವನ ಮಾತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ನೂನ ಇರಲಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಒಪ್ಪಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone agreed that there was no truth lacking in his words.

definition: the sky-blue colour.
example: ಬೆಳಗಿನ ಆಸಮಾನಿ ಆಕಾಶವನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ನಾವು ಮಂತ್ರಮುಗ್ಧರಾದೆವು.
example_en: We were mesmerised looking at the sky-blue morning sky.

definition: something that indicates bounds or limits; a limiting or bounding line; border; frontier.
example: ಎರಡು ಹಳ್ಳಿಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಒಂದು ಸೀಮೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a border between the two villages.

definition: to become restless as from anxiety, fear, disappointment, lack of quietude, etc.
example: ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಬರುವ ಮುನ್ನ ಅವನು ಸುಡುಮಿಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದ.
example_en: He was restless with anxiety before the exam results came.

definition: a female rhinoceros.
example_en: A female rhinoceros was walking in the forest with its young ones.

definition: a contingent of an army (assigned with a special task - details ?).
example: ದಂಡನಾಯಕ ವಿಶೇಷ ಕೋಲಬಲಿಯನ್ನು ಕೋಟೆಯ ರಕ್ಷಣೆಗೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The general sent a special contingent to defend the fort.

definition: the act or an instance of stealing; theft.
example_en: Theft was rampant in that town.

definition: the promise made by a prisoner that he or she would abide by good, prescribed behaviour, for getting released from the confinement; parole.
example: ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ನಡತೆಯಿಂದ ಆ ಕೈದಿಗೆ ಪೆರೋಲು ಸಿಕ್ಕಿತು.
example_en: Because of good conduct, that prisoner got parole.

definition: (phil.) the doctrine or belief that the existing world is the worst possible; pessimism.
example_en: Pessimism was clearly visible in that philosopher's writings.

definition: either of two milk-secreting glands protruding from the upper, front part of a woman's body; a breast.
example_en: The ornament shone upon her breast.

definition: a brave fighter.
example_en: That brave fighter defeated the enemies.

definition: with no name; being anonymous.
example_en: This property was found to be benami (anonymous).

definition: a female tortoise.
example_en: A female tortoise was slowly swimming in the pond.

definition: to be stingy or deal in a miserly manner.
example: ಆ ವ್ಯಾಪಾರಿ ಹಣ ಕೊಡುವಾಗ ಜುಗ್ಗಾಡು ತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That merchant used to be stingy while paying money.

definition: an Indo-Aryan language, the main language of North India; Hindi.
example: ಅವಳು ಹಿಂದಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕನ್ನಡ ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
example_en: She speaks both Hindi and Kannada well.

definition: a plain and open field.
example_en: A green open plain spreads around the village.

definition: a man who contributes to a charitable organisation.
example: ಆ ಚಂದಾದಾರ ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That contributor helps the organisation every year.

definition: the first stage of development of libido in a child; a stage at which the centre of libido or sexual satisfaction lies at the anus; anal eroticism.
example_en: The psychologist gave a lecture on anal eroticism.

definition: to take or bring along with.
example_en: The travelers took along some food with them.

definition: the outer side, part or surface; outside.
example_en: The outside had grown dark.

definition: to set the limits of; to delimit; to demarcate.
example_en: The government demarcated the boundary of this land.

definition: another one; an additional one.
example: ಈ ಕೆಲಸ ಮುಗಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಮತ್ತೊಂದು ಕೆಲಸ ಶುರುವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: After this work was finished, another work began.

definition: a long, foolish or incoherent rambling discourse; rigmarole.
example_en: His talk sounded like a mere long, incoherent rambling discourse.

definition: small; little.
example_en: Small insects were moving about on the leaf.

definition: a respectable, dignified woman.
example_en: That dignified woman was held in respect in the village.

definition: boys collectively.
example_en: Boys had gathered together on the playground.

definition: the first day of the week; Sunday.
example_en: We go to the temple on Sunday.

definition: a hard, heavy blow.
example: ಮರಕ್ಕೆ ಒಂದು ಗಟ್ಟಣೆ ಕೊಟ್ಟು ಹಣ್ಣುಗಳನ್ನು ಉದುರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He gave the tree a hard blow and shook down the fruits.

definition: to rub part of one's own body with the palm.
example: ಅವನು ಕಾಲನ್ನು ಎೞವಿಕೊಂಡು ನೋವನ್ನು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He rubbed his leg with his palm and reduced the pain.

definition: a small passenger-train that runs through a city on rails; a tram-car.
example_en: The tram moved slowly through the middle of the city.

definition: the aloe plant Aloe vera of Liliaceae family.
example_en: She applied the juice of the aloe plant to her face.

definition: any of a family (Fregatidae) of large, tropical pelecaniform birds with extremely long wings and tail and a hooked beak which commonly rob other birds of their prey; a frigate bird.
example_en: A frigate bird was flying along the seashore.

definition: the plant Phaseolus adenanthus.
example_en: The kambeḷagu plant had grown on the field's bund.

definition: the state of being a widow; widowhood.
example_en: Widowhood brought darkness to her life.

definition: a sitting on one's knees.
example: ಆ ಮಗು ಬಯ್ಸಿಕೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಆಟ ಆಡಿತು.
example_en: The child sat kneeling and played.

definition: towards outside.
example_en: He walked towards outside through the door.

definition: the cactus Opuntia dillenii of Cactaceae family having large, flat, oval stem joints and edible fruits; prickly pear.
example: ಮಳೆಯ ನಂತರ ನಾಗದಲೆ ಗಿಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಂಪು ಹಣ್ಣುಗಳು ಕಾಣಿಸಿದವು.
example_en: After the rain, red fruits appeared on the prickly pear plant.

definition: the tendency of spending money extravagantly or wastefully.
example_en: Because of his habit of spending extravagantly, the family sank into debt.

definition: a professional wrestler.
example: ಪೆಹೆಲವಾನ್ ದಿನವೂ ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಕುಸ್ತಿ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: The wrestler practices wrestling every morning.

definition: to increase in size, extent, intensity etc. twofold; to become double.
example_en: Within a single year, the shop's profit doubled.

definition: a periodical gathering of people in a large number at a place for celebrating a festival, social occasion or for buying and selling.
example_en: People came from far off villages for the town's fair.

definition: a particular tāḷa (time in music).
example_en: The musician sang a song in the anutāḷa rhythm.

definition: inability to hear; deafness.
example_en: As he aged, deafness came upon him.

definition: a try, esp. a hard try; attempt; effort.
example: ಅವನು ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗೆಲ್ಲಲು ಬಹಳ ಗೂರಣ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He made a great effort to succeed in the examination.

definition: a thick piece of wood, used as an anvil by a carpenter.
example: ಬಡಗಿಯು ಮರಪಟ್ಟಡಿಯನ್ನು ಉಪಯೋಗಿಸಿ ಮರವನ್ನು ಸಮತಟ್ಟು ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The carpenter used the wooden anvil to level the wood.

definition: the act of beating, stirring or shaking (milk, curd, etc.) to form butter; churning.
example: ಆಕೆ ಮೊಸರಿನ ಕಡೆಹ ಮಾಡಿ ಬೆಣ್ಣೆ ತೆಗೆದಳು.
example_en: She churned the curd and extracted butter.

definition: to take up a cudgel; to ready oneself to fight (with).
example_en: The soldiers readied themselves with cudgels to fight against the enemies.

definition: any of several vegetable substances, as cloves, cinnamon, nutmeg or pepper, that have distinctive flavours and aromas, used to season food.
example_en: When spices were added to the dish, the aroma increased.

definition: he who has lost his reasoning, judging power due to indiscriminate and infatuating love.
example_en: He became one who lost his judgement due to infatuating love.

definition: a headman of a community or a respectable man in a village.
example_en: The village headman gives shelter to everyone.

definition: a going or walking out.
example_en: The king set out for an evening walk.

definition: to cause mental suffering; to inflict grief.
example_en: The death of her son caused the mother mental suffering.

definition: a number of nights, considered together for a purpose.
example: ಅವರು ಗಣರಾತ್ರೆ ಪ್ರಯಾಣ ಮಾಡಿ ಗುರಿ ತಲುಪಿದರು.
example_en: They travelled for a number of nights and reached their destination.

definition: a woman (as the one guarding at the entrance) who is holding a rattan or bamboo stick.
example_en: The woman holding a rattan stick stood at the entrance of the temple.

definition: a temporary mental disorder, with restlessness, excitement, delusions, hallucinations, etc.; a kind of delirium.
example: ಬಿಸಿಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಅಲೆದಾಡಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಸೂರ್ಯಾವರ್ತನ ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: From wandering too much in the sun, he got a bout of delirium.

definition: any of various octopods (order Octopoda) having a soft, saclike body, a reduced coelom, an internal vestigial shell, and eight sucker-bearing arms around the mouth; an octopus.
example_en: The octopus was hiding in a crevice of the rock in the sea.

definition: geometric - a) of or according to geometry; b) characterised by straight lines, triangles, circles or similar regular forms.
example_en: Geometric shapes have been used in this design.

definition: information, news, report that is wrong or baseless.
example_en: Nobody should believe that it is baseless news.

definition: untimely rain; off-season rain.
example_en: This time the crop was ruined by the untimely rain.

definition: a number of transgressions of the moral, religious laws.
example_en: The priest prescribed penance for the many transgressions.

definition: a cut and polished gemstone or a pearl, used for ornamentation; a gem.
example_en: There was a precious gem set in her ring.

definition: the string of a bow.
example_en: The ancient bow's string was made of fibre.

definition: the rising sun.
example_en: The rising sun slowly emerged from the sea.

definition: being distressed; living miserably.
example_en: During the famine, people lived miserably and distressed.

definition: (an emphatic form ) - whosoever - a) any person that; whatever person; b) no matter what person.
example_en: No matter who comes, I will not be afraid.

definition: fire-worship; pyrolatry.
example_en: Fire-worship is performed every day in the temple.

definition: the day after to-day; tomorrow.
example_en: Tomorrow I will go to my hometown.

definition: he who prepares; a preparer.
example: ಆ ಸನ್ನೆಯಗಾರ ಔತಣಕ್ಕೆ ಎಲ್ಲ ಸಿದ್ಧತೆ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: That preparer made all arrangements for the feast.

definition: of reddish brown.
example_en: The color of that cloth was reddish brown.

definition: a coloured liquid used for writing, drawing, etc.; ink.
example_en: Blue ink is needed to write in the exam.

definition: a pea-cock.
example_en: A peacock spread its feathers and danced in the garden.

definition: a horrifying dream.
example: ರಾತ್ರಿ ಬಂದ ಒತ್ತಡೆಯಿಂದ ಮಗು ಬೆಚ್ಚಿ ಎದ್ದಿತು.
example_en: The child woke up startled from the horrifying dream that came at night.

definition: he who sells; a seller.
example_en: That seller sells fruits every day.

definition: having a slim, trim figure; slender.
example: ಆಕೆಯದು ತನುತರ ಶರೀರ, ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಮೆಚ್ಚುಗೆ ಸೂಚಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: She has a slender, trim figure that everyone admired.

definition: to be levelled or smoothened with or as with a plane.
example_en: The carpenter planed the wooden plank smooth.

definition: pain in the stomach or abdomen; stomach-ache.
example_en: He could not sleep all night because of the stomach-ache.

definition: to make another faint from fatigue or by losing strength.
example_en: The heat of the sun made him faint with fatigue.

definition: to enter into a nest.
example_en: The bird entered its nest as the rain started.

definition: beyond measure; immeasurable.
example_en: His happiness was beyond all measure.

definition: an opening caused by or as if by splitting; a hole, slit; fissure or rent.
example_en: A big tear had formed in the cloth.

definition: to increase to result in being three times the original quantity, number, area, etc.
example_en: He tripled his income.

definition: a disorder of an emotional or physical nature; malaise; discomfort or indisposition.
example_en: She felt discomfort due to fever.

definition: the state,fact or quality of being incompetent;incompetence; inefficiency.
example_en: The work was delayed due to that officer's incompetence.

definition: a place, building where a person normally lives in; living quarters.
example: ಅವನ ಪರವರಿ ನದಿಯ ದಂಡೆಯ ಬಳಿ ಇದೆ.
example_en: His living quarters are near the riverbank.

definition: the act of walking, moving.
example_en: People's movement in the street was continuously going on.

definition: any organ or structure, as an eye or a taste bud, containing afferent nerve terminals that are specialised to receive specific stimuli and transmit them to the brain; a receptor; a sense organ.
example_en: The eye is an important sense organ.

definition: dimness or subdued light that follows the sunset.
example_en: In the dim light after sunset, the birds returned to their nests.

definition: name of one of the (one hundred and eight kinds of) time-cycles having particular rhythmic beats.
example_en: The teacher taught the students the samvṛjita time-cycle.

definition: to turn (to one side); to incline toward.
example_en: The boat inclined with the wind and capsized.

definition: a town or village within one's administrative jurisdiction.
example: ಆ ಗ್ರಾಮ ಈ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಯ ಆಳ್ಕೆವಾಡಕ್ಕೆ ಸೇರಿದೆ.
example_en: That village belongs to this officer's administrative jurisdiction.

definition: to come running.
example: ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನು ಮನೆಗೆ ಹರಿತರ್ ಎಂದು ಬಂದನು.
example_en: Hearing the news, he came running home.

definition: a mark, sign, emblem, etc.
example_en: They had placed a mark along the way.

definition: the main entrance in a fort.
example_en: They shut the fort's main entrance and blocked the enemies from entering.

definition: an insane man; a mad man.
example_en: The mad man of the town was wandering in the street.

definition: a kind of farm land.
example_en: The farmer grew paddy on the hasalu land.

definition: something that is written as a memorable, long-cherished achievement.
example_en: His achievement is recorded as a long-cherished, memorable feat.

definition: a man who controls, regulates others or checks or verifies (accounts, actions,procedures, etc.); a controller.
example: ಆ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಕ ಪ್ರತಿ ತಿಂಗಳು ಲೆಕ್ಕಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That controller checks the accounts every month.

definition: the act or fact of waning; a gradual decrease in the size, volume or importance.
example_en: The waning of the moon decreased day by day.

definition: to cause to collide.
example_en: The driver caused the two carts to collide.

definition: a kind of red scorpion.
example_en: The red scorpion stung his leg.

definition: a hand weapon having a long sharp-pointed blade, set in a hilt; a sword.
example_en: The warrior drew the sword from its sheath.

definition: a beloved or lovely woman.
example: ಆ ಕಾಂತೆಯ ನಗು ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: That lovely woman's smile captivated everyone's heart.

definition: to mutter or mumble in discontent, complain in a surly or peevish manner.
example_en: He muttered in discontent out of laziness.

definition: to run the traditional oil mill (drawn by an ox).
example_en: The farmer ran the traditional oil mill early in the morning for oil.

definition: to cause to move (a round object) by turning on its axis or over and over; to roll.
example_en: The children rolled the ball on the ground.

definition: in a straight line or direction; unswervingly.
example_en: He walked straight home along the road.

definition: soiled or soiling with dirt; unclean.
example: ಮಗು ಆಟವಾಡಿ ಗೇಂದಿ ಬಟ್ಟೆಯಿಂದ ಮನೆಗೆ ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: The child came home with dirt-soiled clothes after playing.

definition: a fever that a woman likely to get immediately after giving birth to a child, caused by sepsis; a puerperal fever.
example_en: She contracted puerperal fever after giving birth.

definition: a rope or cord with a loop formed at one end by means of a slipknot so that the loop tightens as the rope or cord is pulled; a noose.
example_en: The hunter tightened a noose around the animal's neck.

definition: the quality that is not befitting a gentleman or regarded as the one that a decent man should not have.
example_en: Unbecoming, ungentlemanly conduct was evident in his behaviour.

definition: the quality or state of being brutal or rough; ruffianism.
example: ಆ ಸೈನಿಕರ ಉದ್ದಟತನ ಗ್ರಾಮಸ್ಥರಿಗೆ ಭಯ ಹುಟ್ಟಿಸಿತು.
example_en: Those soldiers' brutality frightened the villagers.

definition: (mus.) a disagreeing, discordant note.
example_en: A discordant note came from that flute.

definition: the end; termination.
example_en: At the end of the story, the hero attained victory.

definition: the condition of being unattached, unassociated or not associating with others; seclusion; isolation.
example_en: The ascetic lived in the forest in a state of seclusion.

definition: an attacking from all sides.
example_en: The enemies laid siege to the fort from all sides.

definition: a female parent; a mother.
example_en: The mother raised the child with love.

definition: originating, coming from or situated beyond given limits; from some other place, person, group, etc.; outside.
example_en: That item came from an outside town.

definition: the act of abusing, blaming; abuse; blame.
example_en: The abuse directed at her hurt her.

definition: to make a gurgling or rippling sound.
example_en: The spring water was making a gurgling sound.

definition: a man belonging to Spain.
example_en: That Spaniard is learning Kannada.

definition: the humming sound of bees.
example_en: The humming sound of bees could be heard near the flowering plants.

definition: a shop where betel leaves are sold.
example_en: Fresh betel leaves are available at the betel leaf shop.

definition: attracting or capable of attracting; interesting; aesthetically pleasing or appealing; attractive; beautiful.
example: ಆಕೆಯ ಕಮನ ರೂಪ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: Her attractive appearance drew everyone's attention.

definition: a verbal conflict between antagonists; a quarrel.
example_en: A quarrel took place between the two of them in the meeting.

definition: any of a set of hard, bonelike structures set in the jaws of most vertebrates and used for biting, tearing, and chewing: a tooth.

definition: a relatively large ear-ring of gold.
example_en: Her ear-ring was very large.

definition: the evergreen tree Anacardium occidentale of Anacardiaceae family; cashew.

definition: sucked in; absorbed.

definition: a tax levied on the bundles of merchandise.

definition: that part of a stem of a tree, from where the woody extension grows.

definition: a close, trustworthy relative.

definition: a man who receives or can receive; a receiver.

definition: the entire water body that is encircling the land on all the sides.

definition: to separate; to divide; to disunite.

definition: a man who lacks courage in facing danger, difficulty, opposition, pain, etc.; a timid or easily intimidated man.

definition: to shrink from in dislike or disgust; to abhor.

example_en: I have complete confidence in him.

definition: (dance.) a particular movement; elegance in the movements of a dancer.

definition: the act of lifting; an instance of this; a lift.

definition: a loud shout; an outcry.

definition: a harsh, indistinct, grating sound.

example_en: The harsh grating sound of the door broke the night's silence.

definition: the handle of a weapon.

definition: the act or process of blowing, opening or expanding.

definition: the ability, character or methods of a statesman; wisdom, vision and skill in the management of public affairs; statesmanship.
example_en: His statesmanship resolved the nation's problems.
